An equivalent melee replacement used by tier-2 and tier-3 Hanged Man cults. The live unit keeps the current highest unlocked generic melee model, experience, promotions and formation, and gains a fixed +10 or +20 over baseline B. A human attacking it loses Faith scaled by both tiers. This Civilopedia entry explains the mechanic and is not trainable.
Hanged Man tier-2 equivalent replacement: fixed +10 combat strength over the current melee baseline at creation.
Hanged Man tier-3 equivalent replacement: fixed +20 combat strength over the current melee baseline at creation.
